definition: This dimension controls how items of the same type can be combined or stacked in a player's inventory, affecting the overall capacity and organization. Variations can include unlimited stacking, limited stacking with size constraints, or no stacking at all.
exclusion_criteria: Items cannot be stacked at all
Stacking does not influence inventory management strategies
inclusion_criteria: Items of the same type can be stacked to save space
Stacking limits vary based on item type or category
title: Stacking Rules in Inventory Management
